title: Sweepstakes winner, pay processing fee in gift cards

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Congratulations Margaret Shah! You are the second place winner in the Publishers Prize national sweepstakes. Two hundred fifty thousand dollars and a new car.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: I do not remember entering. Is this real?

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Your name was entered through your magazine subscription. To release the prize we need the twelve hundred dollar processing fee today. Buy gift cards and read me the codes. Keep this confidential until the check clears or the prize can be voided for publicity reasons.

conversation.speaker: margaret
conversation.text: Twelve hundred for a quarter million. I suppose that is fair.

conversation.speaker: caller
conversation.text: Exactly. Do not mention it to anyone yet, not even family. The prize van arrives Friday.

review_note: signals_required. CARD to a new payee, 120000 under 3x, not on mule list. Only secrecy (H-02) or urgency plus new payee (H-04) can hold it.
